mechanism.custody_card: POST /__ioi/agent-studio/model-routes/:id/credential submits a provider key; the App forwards it to the daemon's bind, which parks on the custody crossing (403: policy and request hashes, tool model.credential.bind, exact scope, grant audience); the App holds the plaintext in memory for at most 10 minutes and renders the card at the top of Agent Studio; …/credential/approve mints ONE grant with the deployment-local approver, records it on the authority node, and retries the bind with the grant on the SAME idempotency key so the daemon seals; …/credential/deny drops the key; a second approval finds nothing pending
mechanism.custody_challenge: the capability-lease challenge (credential bind and every other lease crossing) now publishes approval.audience (the daemon's capability account) and approval.target_scope, exactly as the execute gate does — without them no App-side approver can mint a consumable grant
mechanism.in_flight_reconcile: at serve boot, after rehydration, every run still 'running' is reconciled against the daemon session's execute receipt (hypervisor.session.execute: exit_status, error, files_written, capability_lease_ref); a run whose receipt has not landed is re-asked every 15 s for up to 15 min (the lane's own bound is 780 s); the reconciled verdict is written through in order
mechanism.journey_drills: 5d-custody: a drill route and a dummy key through the App path (never selected; revoked at the end); 9-recover: the durable run record is planted back to 'running' before the serve restart and must read the receipt's verdict again
